audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side is a blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows while content win[0..6] and the packet levelChart agree on a real curve: Tahm Kench (L1-3), Skill (levels 4-5 through first item), Zilean (2+ items).
audit.why: Content's whys and spikes specifically explain why the curve moves: Zilean has only one bomb charged before level 4 so he can't lock down TK's engage, the matchup evens out once his double-bomb stun and E speed come online, and it swings to Zilean late because Chronoshift makes TK's picks reversible while his slows/speeds out-enable a single-target lockdown tool. The full layer's blanket 'Skill' erases that curve.
audit.corrected: Flipped phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[2].side to Tahm Kench and phases[6].side to Zilean to match win[0], win[1], win[2], win[6] (already correct, so no content edit needed per the chart rule), and rewrote the matching .why for each of those four rows. audit.why: Spikes correctly key to level 2 (single-bomb window, no lockdown), level 6 (Chronoshift undoes the all-in), first item (Time Warp kiting), and late (Chronoshift plus utility out-enables TK).
